trigger: A Termux command behaves differently when pasted, begins with unexpected control-marker text, or reports command-not-found after the executable previously passed version proof.
inputs: literal command line as rendered by the shell

steps.action: Record a redacted literal rendering of the failed command without credentials, device codes or tokens.
If the rendered command begins with [200~ or an equivalent bracketed-paste marker, classify input-framing-corruption before classifying the executable as missing.
Run command -v <executable> and the executable version command using manually typed input when paste framing is suspect.
Compare current command resolution with prior bootstrap proof; contradictory evidence blocks reinstall or package mutation until reconciled.
Retry only the intended one-line command using a trusted input method after framing is clean.
Only when command -v fails and package state confirms absence may the package-install boundary be reopened.

successCondition: The shell receives the intended executable name without framing markers and command resolution agrees with installed-package evidence.
proofCeiling: Terminal input framing and executable resolution only; authentication and downstream command semantics are separate gates.
